scope: This image is qualified only for its own unprofiled three-hour run on the same 512-rank configuration: 545 steps and four full outputs passed the unchanged checker, with all four models and the reader normally closed. Its noon, nine-hour, profile, restart, full 144-hour and clean full-source rebuild scopes remain false. The parent own nine-hour qualification remains historical. Only module_small_step_em.o changed; the other 592 archive members, RSL, provider and all 18 direct inputs are unchanged. Native same-option O2/O0 tests passed 544 complete raw comparisons, including all five processor-state words. The final-RK complete synthetic FINISH caller was 15.3% and 16.8% faster; the nonfinal control showed no consistent gain. These measurements are not a forecast speedup. The source commit records correspondence after testing; raw producer commit remains NULL. Three-hour timing is one unpaired descriptive observation against the fixed median of three original controls; raw A2 remains separate.
